items.title: Moderna, Merck melanoma cancer vaccine is a 'grand slam': Dr. Ezekiel Emanuel
items.summary: Dr. Ezekiel Emanuel sits down with Julie Hyman to discuss the late-stage trial results of the new mRNA cancer treatment vaccine being tested by Moderna (MRNA) and Merck (MRK). Dr. Emanuel was an advisor to President Obama and a member of the Biden-Harris Transition COVID-19 Advisory Board.

items.title: BofA upgrades Moderna after 177% rally driven by cancer vaccine breakthrough
